3d.meta_description: API 3D ah oo bilaash ah, fure la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay wakiilada AI: u rogo qoraal degdeg ah GLB dhab ah, ansaxi oo hagaaji glTF/GLB kasta, oo u gudub heerarka tayada Forge Pro ee lacagta ah iyo Avatars-ka Rigged. Hal URL oo lagu ogaanayo dhammaan — akoon la'aan, fure API la'aan.
3d.meta_og_description: 3D bilaash ah, fure la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay wakiilada: abuurista qabyo 3D ah oo qoraal ka yimid + kormeerka glTF/GLB, oo leh dukumeenti OpenAPI 3.1 oo nadiif ah iyo jaranjaro lacag ah oo loo maro tayada wax-soo-saarka.

3d.meta_title: three.ws API 3D — qoraal→3D bilaash ah + kormeer loogu talagalay wakiilada AI
3d.meta_twitter_description: API 3D oo bilaash ah, furaha la'aan, oo loogu talagalay wakiilada AI: qoraal degdeg ah u beddel moodel GLB dhab ah oo xaqiiji/hagaaji wixii glTF/GLB ah, dhammaantood hal URL oo leh qeexitaan OpenAPI 3.1 oo nool. Abuurista qabyo-qoraalka bilaashka ah iyo kormeerka waxay u gudbaan heerarka tayada Forge Pro ee lacagta ah iyo Avatars-ka la Riggareeyay ee diyaar u ah animation-ka. Fure ma jiro, akoon ma jiro.
3d.output_is_binary_gltf_glb_the_web: Wax-soo-saarku waa binary glTF (GLB) — weelka 3D-ka ee heerka shabakadda ah ee mishiin kasta iyo daawade kasta akhriyo. Kormeerku wuxuu aqbalayaa .glb iyo .gltf oo ka yimid URL kasta oo dadweyne ah, ilaa xadka cabbirka la diiwaangeliyay.
3d.point_any_openapi_toolchain_at_it: Ku tilmaan qalab kasta oo OpenAPI ah.
3d.pre_baked_idle_walk_clip_library: Maktabadda fiidyowyada socodka/nasashada ee horay loo diyaariyay.
3d.programmatically_over_x402_http_402_usdc: Si barnaamij ahaan ah, iyada oo loo marayo x402 (HTTP 402 + USDC oo ku saabsan Base ama Solana). Ma jiro isweydaarsi fure ah – wakiilku wuxuu dib u codsanayaa codsiga isagoo wata madax lacag bixin ah. Ka eeg x402 Bazaar ee lacagta ah buugga dhamaystiran.
3d.real_glb_not_a_screenshot: GLB dhab ah, ma aha shaashad.
3d.start_free_upgrade_only_when_a_draft: Ku bilow bilaash. Kor u qaad kaliya marka qabyo-qoraal aanu ku filnayn. Heerarka lacagta ah waxaa lagu xaliyaa wicitaan kasta USDC iyada oo loo marayo x402 — weli akoon ma jiro, weli fure ma jiro.
3d.text_3d_draft_nim_trellis_single_subject: Qabyo-qoraalka Qoraal→3D (NIM TRELLIS): hal mawduuc, GLB, riggareyn la'aan.
3d.this_is_a_live_gltf_binary_rendered: Kani waa binary glTF oo toos ah oo lagu soo bandhigay biraawsarkaaga. Barta bilaashka ah ee /api/3d/inspect waxay si sax ah u soo sheegtaa waxa ku jira mid ka mid ah kuwan – vertices, triangles, materials, textures, animations, extensions – iyo qorshe mudnaan leh oo lagu yareynayo laguna dedejinayo.
3d.yes_no_account_no_api_key_no: Haa. Akun ma jiro, fure API ma jiro, boorsada ma jirto. Barta bilaashka ah waxay leedahay xaddidaad heer sare ah oo IP kasta ah oo kaliya ka hortagta xadgudubka. Heerka abuurista qabyo-qoraalka bilaashka ah wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa waddo GPU la wadaago – waxay daacad ka tahay inay tahay heer tijaabo ah (qaab-dhismeedka qabyo-qoraalka, GLB kaliya, riggareyn la'aan).

Wuxuu akhriyaa bilawga, garaafka boorsada, iyo socodka dalabka si ka dhaqso badan bini'aadam kasta — ka dibna wuxuu cabbiraa, galaa, oo ka baxaa isaga oo iskiis ah. Goobtaas ka baxsan waxba ma sheeganayo.

artifact_index.embed_your_agent_in_claude_ai: Ku dhex dar wakiilkaaga gudaha Claude.ai
artifact_index.glbs_over_6_mb_are_rejected_claude: GLBs ka badan 6 MB waa la diidaa — guddiga artifact-ka Claude wuu ku dhegi karaa xamuulka waaweyn ee la dhex geliyay. Daawaduhu wuxuu ku daraa 565 KB oo fidsan dusha sare ee moodeelka.
artifact_index.meta_description: Ku dhex dar wakiil three.ws isdhexgal ah gudaha artifact-ka Claude.ai. HTML isku filan, eber ku tiirsanaan dibadeed.
artifact_index.meta_og_description: Wuxuu soo bandhigaa xirmooyinka artifact-ka Claude sida abka isku filan ee la dhex gelin karo.
artifact_index.meta_twitter_description: Wuxuu soo bandhigaa xirmooyinka artifact-ka Claude sida abka isku filan ee la dhex gelin karo.
artifact_index.paste_a_single_url_into_a_claude: Ku dhaji URL keliya wada sheekaysiga Claude. Jawaabtu waa hal dukumeenti HTML ah oo isku filan — three.js, GLTFLoader, iyo GLB-ka wakiilkaaga ayaa dhammaantood lagu daray. Ma jiro qoraal ay xannibtay CSP-ga sandbox-ka Claude, mana jiro wax soo dejin ah oo ka baxa bogga.
artifact_index.the_response_sets_a_csp_mirroring_claude: Jawaabtu waxay dejisaa CSP u dhiganta tan Claude. Dhaqanka horudhaca tooska ah wuxuu la mid yahay dhaqanka gudaha Claude.ai — ma jiraan wax la yaab leh oo u dhexeeya tijaabada iyo wax soo saarka.
artifact_index.three_js_gltfloader_and_the_glb_are: three.js, GLTFLoader, iyo GLB-ka ayaa dhammaantood lagu daray. Boggu wuxuu soo bandhigayaa iyada oo aan wax wicitaanno shabakadeed ah la samayn — si buuxda ula jaanqaadaysa CSP-ga sandbox-ka Claude oo mamnuucaya soo dejinta iyo qoraallada dibadda.

autopilot.meta_description: Geli lacagtaada pump.fun autopilot. Wakiilkaagu wuxuu sameeyaa dib-u-iibsasho wuxuuna u qaybiyaa khidmadaha abuuraha kuwa haysta sida xeerarka aad dejiso — wuxuuna ka sheekeeyaa dhaqdhaqaaq kasta oo silsiladda ah waqtiga dhabta ah.
autopilot.meta_og_description: Wakiil lacag oo madaxbannaan oo sameeya dib-u-iibsasho wuxuuna u qaybiyaa khidmadaha sida xeerarkaaga, oo avatar-kiisu si toos ah uga sheekeeyo.
autopilot.meta_twitter_description: Qolka xakamaynta token-ka oo aan gacanta lagu hayn: dejiso xeerarka — iibsashada, iibinta, iyo ilaalinta — oo u ogolow wakiilkaaga inuu si madaxbannaan u maamulo lacagta.
autopilot.your_agent_runs_the_whole_coin_lifecycle: Wakiilkaagu wuxuu si madaxbannaan u maamulaa wareegga nolosha lacagta oo dhan: wuxuu dib u iibsadaa oo gubaa khidmadaha abuuraha wuxuuna u qaybiyaa lacagaha kuwa haysta — sida xeerarka aad dejiso. Dhaqdhaqaaq kasta oo silsiladda ah waxaa si toos ah uga sheekeeya avatar-ka wakiilkaaga.

autopilot_activity.every_action_your_agent_took_on_your: Tallaabo kasta oo wakiilkaagu ku qaaday magacaaga — mid walba oo ku salaysan xusuusta dhiirigelisay, saxiixan, oo la celin karo meeshii ay suurtagal tahay. Tani waa madaxbannaani aad hubin karto.
autopilot_activity.meta_description: Tallaabo kasta oo madaxbannaan oo wakiilkaaga three.ws uu qaaday — mid walba oo leh xusuusta dhiirigelisay, rasiid saxiixan, iyo dib u celin hal taabasho ah. Madaxbannaani la fahmi karo oo aad ku kalsoonaan karto.

Kaar kasta oo hoose wuxuu sheegashadiisa ku xiraa waxa aan cabbirnay, wuxuu isku xiraa demo-ga dhabta ah marka la soo diro, wuxuuna yiraahdaa "soo socda" — ma aha isku xir aan shaqaynayn — marka aan la soo dirin.
bnb.the_block_time_number_above_is_measured: Tirada waqtiga xannibaadda ee kor ku xusan waxaa si toos ah looga cabbiraa BSC RPC dadweyne mar kasta oo bogga la shubo (probeBlockTime, iyadoo la qaadanayo 200 xannibaad oo dhab ah) — waligeed ma aha "0.45s" oo go'an.
bnb.three_things_only_bnb_chain_lets_us: Saddex shay oo kaliya BNB Chain ay noo ogolaato inaan dhisno.
bnb.three_tracks_each_honestly_gated: Saddex jid, mid kasta si daacad ah loo xiray
bnb.verified_2026_07_07_3_vote_adversarial: La xaqiijiyay 2026-07-07, dib u eegis ka soo horjeeda oo 3-cod ah
bnb.we_never_claim_bnb_s_roadmap_targets: Weligeen ma sheeganayno yoolalka khariidadda waddada ee BNB — 20,000 TPS, 250ms dhammaystir (BEP-670), ama "qaab-dhismeedka wakiilka AI" ee heerka silsiladda — in la soo diray. Kaliya waxa aan annagu cabbirnay.

bnb_latency.a_chain_s_rpc_going_quiet_shows: RPC-ga silsiladda oo aamusa wuxuu muujiyaa "dib u xirid" jidkaas oo kaliya; inta kale ee tartanka ayaa sii socota. Dhammaan afarta oo isku mar hoos u dhaca waxay muujinayaan qalad la qorsheeyay oo dib u tijaabin ah, waligeed ma aha bog madhan.
bnb_latency.each_card_samples_real_blocks_or_slots: Kaar kasta wuxuu ka qaadaa xannibaado dhab ah (ama boosas, ee Solana) RPC dadweyne wuxuuna soo sheegaa celceliska cabbiran ee u dhexeeya — sparkline-ku waa 24-kii akhris ee ugu dambeeyay ee tooska ah, baararka ugu dheer = cabbirka ugu dhaqsaha badan.
bnb_latency.every_chain_s_public_rpc_is_unreachable: RPC-ga dadweynaha ee silsilad kasta lama gaari karo hadda — tani waa cilad dhab ah, ma aha bug. Dib u tijaabi, ama dib u eeg wax yar ka dib.
bnb_latency.every_number_comes_from_which_samples_re: Tiro kasta waxay ka timaaddaa /api/bnb/latency, kaas oo ka qaada xannibaado dhab ah (BNB iyada oo loo marayo probeBlockTime, shaqada la midka ah ee taageerta xariijinta caddaynta ee /bnb hub) RPC-yada dadweynaha mar kasta oo la codsado — waxba lama sii xisaabin ama lama go'in.
bnb_latency.four_lanes_one_honest_race_bnb_chain: Afar jid, hal tartan oo daacad ah: BNB Chain, Base, Ethereum, iyo Solana, mid kasta si toos ah ayaa looga cabbiraa RPC dadweyne dhowr ilbiriqsi kasta — waligeed ma aha "0.45s" oo go'an. Jid aamusa wuxuu muujiyaa "dib u xirid," ma aha tiro been abuur ah oo qabow, halka kuwa kale ay sii tartamayaan.
bnb_latency.how_we_keep_this_race_honest: Sida aan tartankan u ilaalino daacadnimadiisa.

demos_audio2face.powered_by_nvidia_audio2face_3d_over_nvc: Waxaa ku shaqeeya /api/a2f (NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D oo ku shaqeeya NVCF gRPC) iyo /api/tts/speak (NVIDIA Magpie). Khariidadda blendshape→morph waxay ku jirtaa src/voice/a2f-player.js — waxay dib u isticmaashaa ereyada ARKit/VRM/Oculus ee ku jira src/voice/arkit-blendshapes.js, sidaa darteed rig kasta oo bini'aadan ah wuxuu samaynayaa lip-sync iyada oo aan loo baahnayn liis gaar ah. Fiiri demo-ga lipsync-ka amplitude-kaliya si aad u aragto habka dib u dhaca.

demos_audio2face.type_a_line_it_s_spoken_in: Qor xariiq. Waxaa lagu hadlaa codka NVIDIA Magpie, codkaas saxda ahna waxaa loo diraa NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, kaasoo soo celiya ARKit blendshape track oo frame-ka ah. Afka iyo wejiga avatar-ku waxay u dhaqaaqaan frame-ka-frame-ka codka dhabta ah — lagu jaan-gooyay qaab kasta oo morph-target ah oo GLB la soo raray uu wato (ARKit, common avatar-platform, VRM, Oculus visemes). Haddii Audio2Face aan la heli karin, avatar-ku weli wuu hadlaa oo wuxuu ku noqdaa amplitude lipsync — weligiis ma aha waji qabow.

docs_walk_chrome_extension.because_you_can_enable_the_avatar_on: Sababtoo ah waxaad ku shidi kartaa avatar-ka goob kasta oo aad booqato. Duritaanku weli wuxuu ka dhacaa oo kaliya tabsyada aad shiddo.

docs_walk_chrome_extension.enable_on_this_site_a_toggle_that: Ku daar goobtan — badal avatar-ka ku dhejiya/ka saara tabka hadda jira, iyadoo domain-ka la tusay. Waa la damiyay bogagga xaddidan (chrome://, iwm.).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.everything_stays_on_your_device_except_t: Wax walba waxay ku sii jiraan qalabkaaga marka laga reebo codsiyada qoraalka-ilaa-hadalka, kuwaas oo loo diro three.ws si ay u soo saaraan cod. Xeerarka goobtaada iyo dookhyadaada waxaa lagu kaydiyaa kaydka isku xiran ee Chrome.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.fetch_your_avatars_featured_avatars_and_: Soo qaado avataradaada, avatarada la soo bandhigay, iyo codadka TTS, oo u adeegso iframe-ka socodka.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.inject_the_avatar_into_your_active_tab: Ku dur avatar-ka tabkaaga firfircoon — kaliya marka aad shiddo, waligiis si otomaatig ah maaha.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.keep_the_avatar_in_sync_as_you: Ku hay avatar-ka isku xiran markaad dhex-gasho, qiimee xeerarka goobtaada, oo u gudbi isbeddelada goobaha tooska ah tabsyada la rakibay.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.light_dark_or_auto_samples_the_page: Iftiin, Madow, ama Auto (wuxuu qaadaa asalka bogga).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.meta_description: Kordhinta Chrome-ka ee three.ws Walk Avatar: ku socodsii avatar-kaaga goob kasta, habbee muuqaalka iyo xeerarka goob-gaarka ah, oo bogagga ku akhri cod-u-qorid. Rakibid, ogolaansho, iyo habayn.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.mounts_your_avatar_on_any_site_the: Avatar-kaaga ku dheji goob kasta. Avatar-ku waa isla iframe-ka hufan ee /walk-embed, kaas oo lagu duro tab-ka hadda jira marka aad shido.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.persist_your_chosen_avatar_walk_speed_po: Hayso avatar-kaaga la doortay, xawaaraha socodka, booska, xeerarka goobta, iyo habaynta sheekada (oo lagu waafajiyay dhammaan aaladahaaga Chrome).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.picked_from_the_three_ws_tts_voice: Laga soo xulay liiska codadka TTS ee three.ws.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.read_the_current_tab_s_hostname_to: Akhri magaca martigeliyaha tab-ka hadda jira si aad u calaamadiso "Ku shid goobtan" oo aad u gudbiso shidmaadaada tab-kaas.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.reads_pages_aloud_optional_with_narratio: Bogagga ayuu cod dheer ku akhriyaa (ikhtiyaari). Marka sheekada la shido, wuxuu ogaadaa maqaalka ugu muhiimsan, wuxuu la socdaa waxa muuqda, wuxuuna ku hadlaa qaybaha muuqda isagoo isticmaalaya cod-u-qorid.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.requires_chrome_109_or_newer_manifest_v3: Wuxuu u baahan yahay Chrome 109 ama ka cusub (Manifest V3). Si aad u xirxirto zip diyaar u ah dukaanka, ku shaqee npm run build:extension:prod, kaas oo soo saara dist/extension-<version>.zip.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.respects_your_rules_per_site_enabling_pl: Wuxuu ixtiraamaa xeerarkaaga. Shidid goob-gaar ah oo lagu daray liis-ogolaansho/liis-mamnuucid, mana isku duro si toos ah — wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa oo kaliya meesha aad ka codsato.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.small_medium_large_or_custom_width_heigh: Yar, Dhexdhexaad, Weyn, ama ballac × dherer gaar ah.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_extension_is_built_from_this_reposit: Kordhinta waxaa laga dhisay kaydkan waxaana lagu shubay si aan la xirxirin. (Waxaa loo diyaariyay Dukaanka Shabakadda Chrome; liis dadweyne weli lama heli karo, markaa ku rakib habka horumariyaha.)
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_extension_requests_the_minimum_it_ne: Kordhinta waxay codsataa waxa ugu yar ee ay u baahan tahay waxayna ku durtaa oo kaliya ficil cad oo isticmaale.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_three_ws_walk_avatar_extension_v1: Kordhinta three.ws Walk Avatar (v1.0.0) waxay ku dhejisaa avatar 3D ah oo sabbaynaya bog kasta oo aad booqato. Waxay kula socotaa waxayna ku akhrin kartaa qaybaha bogga cod dheer — saaxiib daalacasho oo nool. Waxay ku shaqeysaa oo kaliya tab-yada aad si cad u shido.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.with_narration_on_the_extension_parses_t: Markii sheekayntu shidan tahay, kordhinta ayaa falanqaysa maqaalka ugu muhiimsan bogga (iyadoo la isticmaalayo soo saare Readability ah oo ku jira), waxay soo saartaa cinwaannada, cutubyada, qodobada liiska, iyo xigashooyinka, waxayna daawataa qaybta muuqata. Marka qayb diiradda saarto, waxay cod ka codsataa adeegga qoraalka-ilaa-codka ee three.ws oo ay ciyaartaa, iyadoo u sheegaysa avatar-ka inuu muujiyo xumbo hadal oo uu u beddelo qaab aan firfircoonayn. Adiga ayaa dooranaya codka, waad aamusiin kartaa inta akhriska lagu jiro, sheekayntuna waxay ixtiraamtaa prefers-reduced-motion. Qorayaashu waxay ku calaamadin karaan qaybaha data-walk-narrate (ama way ka boodi karaan data-walk-narrate="skip").

docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_a_three_ws_site: Habka wehelka waa muuqaal goobta three.ws ah. Si aad avatar socda ugu darto goobtaada gaarka ah, isticmaal JavaScript SDK-ga hal-tag ah; si aad avatar-kaaga ugu socodsiiso goob kasta oo aad booqato, ku rakib kordhinta Chrome.
docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_the_platform_integrati: Habka wehelka waa isdhexgalka madal ee SDK-ga socodka la daabici karo. Hagidda three.ws waxay gelisaa qoraalka wehelka kaliya marka wehelka la shido — bog aan waligiis shidin waxba kama bixiyo. Gudaha, waxay soo shubtaa muujinta animation-ka avatar-ka ee horay loo diyaariyey iyo mashiinka soo-bandhigidda isku midka ah ee ay isticmaalaan bogga socodka iyo ku-xidhnaanta.
docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_the_site_wide_walking: Habka wehelka waa avatar-ka socda ee goobta oo dhan ee three.ws. Daar oo avatar-kaagu wuu ka go'ayaa chrome-ka bogga, wuxuu ku wareegayaa shaashadda, wuxuuna ku raacayaa markaad u kala gudubto bogagga — oo ay ku jiraan kala-guurka bogga ee socodka-ogaal ah.
docs_walk_companion_mode.detaches_and_roams_your_avatar_leaves_th: Wuu go'ayaa oo wareegayaa. Avatar-kaagu wuxuu ka baxayaa qaabka bogga wuxuuna noqonayaa jilaa 3D ah oo xor ah oo aad daawan karto isagoo socda.
docs_walk_companion_mode.follows_you_between_pages_when_you_navig: Wuxuu kugu raacayaa bogagga dhexdooda. Markaad hagto, wehelku wuu sii jiraa — kala-guurka bogga ee socodka-ogaal ahna wuxuu u habaynayaa boodboodka si uu ula jaanqaado meesha aad u socoto.
docs_walk_companion_mode.meta_description: Habka wehelka: avatar three.ws ah oo goobta oo dhan ah oo ka go'a bogga, ku wareegaya, kugu raacaya bogagga dhexdooda — oo ay ku jiraan kala-guurka bogga ee socodka-ogaal ah iyo gacan-haad macasalaamayn / gacan-haad soo dhawayn.
docs_walk_companion_mode.nav_button_the_walk_control_in_the: Badhanka hagidda — xakamaynta Socodka ee hagidda sare waxay shidaa oo damisaa wehelka. Doorashada waa la xusuustaa booqashooyinka oo dhan.
docs_walk_companion_mode.picks_an_avatar_the_picker_includes_a: Wuxuu doortaa avatar. Xulashada waxaa ku jira xiriiriye "samee adiga kuu gaar ah" oo si toos ah u tagaya istudiyaha avatar-ka.
docs_walk_companion_mode.programmatically_the_companion_instance_: Si barnaamij ahaan — nuqulka wehelka wuxuu diyaar yahay window.__walkCompanion marka la shido (kani waa isdhexgalka ay hagiddu waddo).
docs_walk_companion_mode.query_parameter_append_to_any_three_ws: Halbeegga Weydiinta — ku dar ?walk=1 URL kasta oo three.ws ah si aad u shiddo, ama ?walk=0 si aad u damiso.
docs_walk_companion_mode.the_companion_and_its_page_transitions_r: Wehelka iyo isbeddelada boggiisa waxay ixtiraamaan prefers-reduced-motion. Avatar-ka wareegaya waa qurxin; dhammaan hagidda iyo waxa ku jira waxay ahaanayaan kuwo si buuxda loo isticmaali karo iyadoo wehelku dansan yahay, taas oo ah xaaladda asalka ah ilaa aad doorato inaad shiddo.
docs_walk_companion_mode.waves_goodbye_and_hello_on_a_link: Macasalaameyn iyo soo dhoweyn. Marka la gujiyo xiriiriye, avatar-ku wuxuu ciyaaraa hir wuxuuna dejinayaa calaamad hal-mar ah oo bogga loo socdo uu akhriyo si uu dib ugu soo dhaweeyo marka uu shaqeeyo.

docs_walk_embed_api.a_command_was_rejected_or_a_load: Amar waa la diiday ama rarku wuu fashilmay. Marnaba ma qaado xaalad gudaha ah.

docs_walk_embed_api.a_live_avatar_swap_finished_loading: Beddelka avatar-ka tooska ah ayaa dhameeyay raridda.
docs_walk_embed_api.a_real_iframe_driven_through_the_sdk: iframe dhab ah oo /walk-embed ah, oo lagu maamulo SDK-ga. Dir amarro oo daawo diiwaanka dhacdooyinka oo si toos ah u cusboonaysiinaya — dhacdooyinka baxaya oo cagaaran, amarada aad dirto oo buluug ah, qaladka oo cas.
docs_walk_embed_api.accepts_an_avatar_id_a_site_path: a.setAvatar(id) — wuxuu aqbalaa aqoonsiga avatar-ka, waddo goobeed, ama GLB URL.
docs_walk_embed_api.avatar_animation_clips_finished_loading_: Avatar-ka + fiidyowyada dhaqdhaqaaqa ayaa dhameeyay raridda. Dib ayaa loo diray jawaabta walk:ping.
docs_walk_embed_api.background_a_hex_color_or_an_string: Gadaal (config.bg): daahfuran, midab hex ah, ama xarig rgb()/rgba() ah.
docs_walk_embed_api.every_message_both_directions_is_a_plain: Fariin kasta — labada jiho — waa shay fudud oo leh ilaaliye kanaal iyo nooc, si aan marnaba loogu khaldin taraafikada maktabad kale ee postMessage:
docs_walk_embed_api.everything_inbound_is_validated_numbers_: Wax kasta oo soo galaya waa la xaqiijiyay. Nambarada waa la xaddiday, xargaha waa la xaddiday dhererkooda, enums-ka waa la hubiyay, waxaana config.bg lagu xaddiday qaababka midabada badbaadada leh. Amar xun wuxuu keenaa walk:error, marnaba ma tuuro.
docs_walk_embed_api.feature_detect_at_runtime_via_the_sdk: Aqoonso astaanta xilliga shaqada iyadoo la isticmaalayo ThreeWalkAvatar.protocol (SDK-ga) ama window.WALK_EMBED_PROTOCOL (gudaha daaqadda lagu dhejiyay).
docs_walk_embed_api.gestures_and_are_one_shots_that_settle: Dhaqdhaqaaqyada: taagan, socod, orod, gacan-haadin, boodid. Gacan-haadin iyo boodid waa dhaqdhaqaaqyo hal mar ah oo ku soo noqda xaaladdii taagan; inta kale waxay xakameeyaan socodka.
docs_walk_embed_api.held_analog_drive_1_1_per_axis: a.move(x, y, run) — xakamaynta analogga ah ee la hayo (−1…1 dhidib kasta).
docs_walk_embed_api.if_you_talk_to_the_iframe_directly: Haddii aad si toos ah ula xiriirto iframe-ka (oo aan lahayn SDK), u dir xirmada iframe.contentWindow oo ka akhri dhacdooyinka window:
docs_walk_embed_api.meta_description: Heshiiska postMessage ee labada dhinac ah ee three.ws avatar-ka socda ee la galiyay: dhacdooyinka baxaya, amarrada soo galaya, JS SDK-ga, qaabka amniga, iyo tusaalooyin React, Vue, iyo vanilla ah oo la koobiyeeyo oo la dhejiyo.
docs_walk_embed_api.meta_og_description: Ku kaxee avatar 3D ah oo socda bog kasta. Dhacdooyinka postMessage, ThreeWalkAvatar SDK-ga, amniga, iyo tusaalooyin React / Vue / vanilla ah.
docs_walk_embed_api.meta_twitter_description: Ku kaxee avatar 3D ah oo socda bog kasta. Dhacdooyinka postMessage, ThreeWalkAvatar SDK-ga, amniga, iyo tusaalooyin React / Vue / vanilla ah.
docs_walk_embed_api.nothing_internal_leaks_outbound_messages: Wax gudaha ah ma daadanayo. Fariimaha baxaya waxay wataan oo kaliya goobaha ku qoran miisaska sare — weligood ma wataan calaamadaha fadhiga, URL-yada isha avatar-ka, ama xaaladda muuqaalka. Isweydaarsiga avatar-ka tooska ah wuxuu soo sheegaa avatarId-ka dadweynaha ee aad siisay, ma aha URL-ka CDN ee la xaliyay.
docs_walk_embed_api.origin_allow_listing_is_opt_in_the: Liiska ogolaanshaha asalka waa doorasho. Gelinta waxay la socotaa frame-ancestors * si ay ugu shaqeyso goob kasta, sidaa darteed soo-gelinta waa la ogol yahay si caadi ah. Ku xidh ?allowOrigins=https://your.site (iyo ?targetOrigin= si aad u xidho meesha dhacdooyinka lagu dhejiyo) marka aad taqaano martigeliyaha saxda ah.
docs_walk_embed_api.re_request_the_sdk_fires_this_for: a.ping() — dib u codso walk:ready (SDK-gu wuxuu tan kuu shidaa marka la xiro).
docs_walk_embed_api.recenter_and_stop_all_motion: a.reset() — dib u dhexeey oo jooji dhaqdhaqaaq kasta.
docs_walk_embed_api.render_the_iframe_then_wrap_it_with: Soo bandhig iframe-ka, ka dibna ku duub SDK-ga si aad u hesho API amar iyo dhacdo oo nadiif ah, oo aan ballan qaad lahayn:
docs_walk_embed_api.send_these_to_drive_the_avatar_with: Kuwaas u dir si aad u dhaqaajiso avatar-ka. SDK-ga, mid walba wuxuu u dhigmaa hab; iyadoo la isticmaalayo postMessage cayriin ah, dir baqshadda nooca leh (eeg Envelope]). Amar kasta waa la xaqiijiyaa oo lagu xiraa gudaha iframe-ka ka hor inta uusan taaban avatar-ka.
docs_walk_embed_api.source_is_the_real_authentication_the_if: Isha ayaa ah xaqiijinta dhabta ah. Iframe-ku wuxuu aqbalaa oo kaliya amarada uu daaqadiisa isha ahi tahay waalidkiisa; SDK-gu wuxuu aqbalaa oo kaliya dhacdooyinka uu isha ahi tahay iframe-ka uu duubo. Isha la been abuuray ma geli karto si kasta.
docs_walk_embed_api.speed_a_walk_speed_multiplier_clamped_to: Xawaaraha (config.speed): kordhiye xawaaraha socodka ah, ku xiran 0.3…3.
docs_walk_embed_api.the_accepted_values_for_the_enumerated_p: Qiimayaasha la aqbalay ee goobaha xogta la tiriyey:
docs_walk_embed_api.the_avatar_moves_throttled_to_10_hz: Avatar-ku wuu dhaqaaqaa. Xawaarihiisa waa la xaddiday ilaa ≤ 10 Hz; jihada waa wareegga jihada ee radians.
docs_walk_embed_api.the_avatar_starts_speaking_is_how_long: Avatar-ku wuxuu bilaabayaa hadalka. durationMs waa inta ay xumbo-hadalku kor joogto.
docs_walk_embed_api.the_embed_emits_these_as_you_drive: Embed-ku wuxuu soo saaraa kuwan marka aad dhaqaajiso iyo marka avatar-ku noloshiisa ku jiro. Ku biir avatar.on(name, cb); callback-ku wuxuu helayaa shayga fariinta.
docs_walk_embed_api.the_same_integration_in_three_flavours_a: Isku xirnaanta isku mid ah oo saddex nooc ah. Saddexduba waxay isticmaalaan SDK-ga aan ku tiirsanayn.
docs_walk_embed_api.the_walking_avatar_embed_is_programmable: Embed-ka avatar-ka socda waa la barnaamijayn karaa. Ku rid iframe-ka /walk-embed bog kasta oo ku dhaqaaji heshiis postMessage ah oo nooca leh, laba-jiho ah — ama si buuxda uga bood qaabka xadhkaha oo isticmaal SDK-ga ThreeWalkAvatar. Boggan waa tixraaca buuxa: dhacdo kasta, qaabka amniga, goob ciyaar oo toos ah, iyo tusaalooyin la koobiyeeyo oo la dhejiyo.
docs_walk_embed_api.walks_to_the_point_then_stops_clamped: a.goto(x, z) — wuxuu u socdaa barta ka dibna wuu istaagaa (ku xiran saxanka dhulka).
docs_walk_embed_api.world_bounds_targets_are_clamped_to_a: Xuduudaha adduunka: bartilmaameedyada goto waxaa lagu xiraa gacan dhan ~11.5 m (saxanka dhulka).

docs_walk_embed_iframe.allow_list_of_origins_permitted_to_send: Liiska la oggol yahay ee isha loo oggol yahay inay soo dirto amarada soo galaya.
docs_walk_embed_iframe.background_fill_a_hex_value_e_g: Buuxinta asalka. Qiime hex ah (tusaale %23101820) wuxuu beddelaa midabka cad ee deegaanka horay loo dejiyay.
docs_walk_embed_iframe.drag_to_orbit_the_camera_disable_for: Jiid si aad u wareejiso kamarada. Demi kuwa aan isdhexgalka lahayn, kuwa si toos ah u ciyaara oo kaliya.

docs_walk_embed_iframe.glb_vrm_url_or_avatar_uuid: GLB / VRM URL, ama avatar UUID

docs_walk_embed_iframe.input_method_shows_an_on_screen_stick: Habka gelinta. joystick wuxuu muujiyaa ul shaashadda ah, keyboard wuxuu awood siiyaa WASD/fallooyinka, none wuxuu joojiyaa gelinta.

docs_walk_embed_iframe.is_a_chrome_less_transparent_page_that: /walk-embed waa bog aan lahayn chrome, oo hufan kaas oo soo bandhigaya hal avatar. Waxay la socotaa frame-ancestors *, si aad ugu riddo <iframe> meel kasta oo laga soo jeedo oo aad wax walba ku habayn karto iyada oo loo marayo cabbirrada su'aalaha URL-ka.
docs_walk_embed_iframe.live_preview_of_the_embed_above: Horudhac toos ah oo ku daridda sare ah
docs_walk_embed_iframe.meta_description: Ku dar avatar socda three.ws oo leh iframe caadi ah. Cabbir kasta oo su'aalaha /walk-embed ah — avatar, kontaroolada, deegaanka, autoplay, dhulka, orbit, bg — lagu diiwaangeliyay horudhac toos ah.

docs_walk_embed_iframe.restrict_outbound_events_to_a_single_ori: Xaddid dhacdooyinka postMessage ee dibadda u baxa hal meel oo laga soo jeedo.
docs_walk_embed_iframe.scene_preset_sets_background_fog_ground_: Goob horay loo sii dejiyay — wuxuu dejiyaa asalka, ceeryaanta, dhulka, iyo iftiinka.
docs_walk_embed_iframe.start_the_avatar_walking_a_slow_circle: Bilow avatarka oo wareegaya wareeg gaabis ah si aanu ku dariddu marnaba u noqon mid taagan.
docs_walk_embed_iframe.the_ground_disc_set_to_float_the: Saxanka dhulka. Deji false si aad avatarka ugu sabbayso asalka martigeliyaha oo leh hadh jilicsan oo kaliya.

evm_wallet.grind_a_real_ethereum_evm_wallet_whose: Soo saar boorsada Ethereum / EVM dhab ah oo ciwaankeedu ku bilaabmo ama ku dhammaado xarfo aad dooratay — wakiilkaaga, khasnaddaada, ama meel kasta oo ciwaan xusuus leh 0x uu muhiim yahay. Natiijadu waa labo fure oo secp256k1 ah oo caadi ah oo aad ku soo dhoofsan karto MetaMask, ethers, viem ama Rabby. Waxay si buuxda ugu shaqeysaa biraawsarkaaga. Furaha gaarka ah waligiis lama gudbiyo meelna.
evm_wallet.hex_characters_only_0_9_a_f: Xarfo hex ah oo kaliya (0–9, a–f). Xaraf kasta oo dheeraad ah wuxuu 16 jeer ka adag yahay. Xarfo isku dhafan (tusaale BeeF) waxay u dhigmaan EIP-55 checksum — si muuqaal ah ayay u kala duwan yihiin, ~2 jeer ayay ka adag yihiin xaraf kasta.
evm_wallet.meta_description: Soo saar ciwaan boorsada Ethereum / EVM ah oo gaar ah oo leh horgale ama dabagale aad dooratay. features.pick_an_avatar_configure_size_and_style: Dooro avatar, hagaaji cabbirka iyo qaabka, ka dibna koobiyeey hal calaamad qoraal. Ku dheji Notion, Ghost, WordPress, Framer — meel kasta.

features.the_latest_features_each_linked_to_the: Astaamaha iyo daahfurka ugu dambeeyay, mid kasta oo ku xiran bogga tooska ah. Liiskani wuxuu isku cusboonaysiiyaa sii-deyn kasta.
features.the_web_component_lazy_loads_renders_on: Qaybta shabakadda <agent-3d> si fudud ayay u shubantaa, waxay ka shaqeysaa qalab kasta, waxayna ku xirantaa nidaamkaaga AI ee jira iyadoo la isticmaalayo MCP ama A2A. Ma jiro framework. Ma jiro tallaabo dhisid.
features.the_whole_product_making_avatars_buildin: Alaabta oo dhan — samaynta avatars, dhisidda wakiillada AI, meel kasta oo aad rabto ku dhejinta — waxay ku shaqaysaa kaliya email. Astaamaha blockchain-ka ee hoose waa kuwo ikhtiyaari ah oo aad gadaal ka shidan karto.
features.these_features_use_crypto_to_switch_them: Astaamahani waxay isticmaalaan crypto. Si aad u shiddo waxaad u baahan tahay boorso iyo lacag yar oo ah USDC ama SOL. Si buuxda uga bood, alaabta asaasiga ah ee sare weli si buuxda ayay u shaqaynaysaa.
features.walk_your_avatar_through_3d_worlds_tied: Ku socodsii avatar-kaaga adduunyo 3D ah oo ku xiran qiimaha crypto ee tooska ah. Dhulku wuu isbeddelaa suuqa la socda — adduun kastaa waa muuqaalka token kale.
features.watch_two_ai_agents_oracle_and_nova: Daawo laba wakiil oo AI ah — ORACLE iyo NOVA — oo gorgortamaya, isku yeeraya xirfadahooda, oo si toos ah u xallinaya lacag-bixinnada blockchain-ka. Ma jiraan dad ku lug leh.
features.why_it_s_better_agents_in_the: Maxay uga fiican tahay: Wakiilada adduunka waxay isku bixiyaan si toos ah, silsiladda xogta dushiisa — waxaadna daawan kartaa x402 dhaqdhaqaaqyada lacagaha yaryar ee tooska ah oo dhacaya adigoo socda.
features.why_it_s_better_any_llm_works: Maxay uga fiican tahay: LLM kasta wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa iyadoo la isticmaalayo MCP ama A2A — Claude, GPT, Gemini, ama kaaga. Ma jiro ku xirnaansho hal shirkad.
features.why_it_s_better_every_avatar_and: Maxay uga fiican tahay: Avatar kasta iyo wakiil kasta oo aad abuurto si toos ah ayuu halkan uga soo muuqdaa — waxba ma jiraan oo aad isku xirto, hal galitaan ayay dhammaantood leeyihiin.
features.why_it_s_better_it_s_a: Maxay uga fiican tahay: Waa daahfur dhab ah oo leh ganacsi toos ah laga bilaabo ilbidhiqsigii ugu horreeyay — adiga ayaa bixiya faahfaahinta, annaga ayaa gacanta ku hayna farsamada blockchain-ka.
features.why_it_s_better_no_app_install: Maxay uga fiican tahay: Ma jiro rakibid app — wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa browser-ka isagoo leh fiisikis dhab ah (Rapier) iyo dhul dhab ah, ma aha meel fidsan.
features.why_it_s_better_no_sdk_required: Maxay uga fiican tahay: Looma baahna SDK dhinaca macaamilka — hal tag, bog kasta, ma jiro tallaabo dhisid.
features.why_it_s_better_outputs_are_glb: Maxay uga fiican tahay: Wax-soo-saarku waa GLB-diyaar — si toos ah ugu shub daawadaha, geyso, ama ku dheji iyada oo aan loo baahnayn tallaabo beddelid.
features.why_it_s_better_pay_per_call: Maxay uga fiican tahay: Bixinta-wacitaan-kasta macnaheedu waa ma jiraan is-diiwaangelinno la maareeyo — iibsadayaashu waxay bixiyaan waxa ay isticmaalaan, adigana waxaa lagu siiyaa lacag wacitaan kasta.
features.why_it_s_better_real_on_chain: Maxay uga fiican tahay: Xallin dhab ah oo blockchain-ka ah iyadoo la isticmaalayo bixinta-wacitaan-kasta (lacag-bixinno yaryar) — macaamil kasta waa la xaqiijin karaa, ma aha mid la jilay.
features.why_it_s_better_sub_cent_fees: Maxay uga fiican tahay: Kharashyo ka yar hal senti. Adiga ayaa furihii haysta. Kaarka wakiilku waa URL JSON ah oo dadweynaha u furan — waxba kuma xirna boggan.
features.why_it_s_better_the_rig_is: Maxay uga fiican tahay: Rig-gu wuxuu diyaar u yahay animation — si toos ah ayaad ugu shubi kartaa daawadaha oo aad isla markiiba u kicin kartaa animation kasta.
features.why_it_s_better_these_are_real: Maxay uga fiican tahay: Kuwani waa wicitaanno API dhab ah oo Granite ah — ma aha kuwo la jilay — iyadoo go'aan kasta lagu xiray macaamil Solana ah oo ah diiwaan aan la beddeli karin.
features.why_it_s_better_three_ar_methods: Maxay uga fiican tahay: Saddex hab oo AR ah oo hal badhan ah — iOS Quick Look, Android Scene Viewer, iyo WebXR. Midka saxda ah si toos ah ayuu u shaqeeyaa. Wakiilku wuxuu ku sii jiraa WebXR, sidaa darteed wada-hadalka iyo animations-ku waxay ka shaqeeyaan AR.

features_ar.place_a_forged_3d_product_on_a: Dhiga badeecad 3D ah oo la sameeyay shelf dhab ah ka hor inta aan la bilaabin wax soo saarka. Arag cabbirada saxda ah iyo dhammaystirka meeshaada dhabta ah.
features_ar.place_characters_props_and_scenes_in_rea: Dhiga jilayaasha, agabka, iyo muuqaalada deegaanno dhab ah si loo abuuro content, suuqgeyn, ama khibrado isdhexgal ah.

features_ar.tap_place_in_your_space_the_model: Taabo 'Place in your space'. Model-ku wuxuu u muuqdaa mid ku xiran dushaas cabbirka dhabta ah ee adduunka. Ku wareeg. Farta ku qabso si aad u yareyso/weyneeyso.

forge.multi_engine_pipeline_engines_marked_fre: Nidaamka shaqo ee mashiino badan. Mashiinada lagu calaamadeeyay BILAASH waxay ku shaqeeyaan furaha la'aan: Abuuridda ay martigeliso NVIDIA iyo shaqaaleheena GPU-ga ee aan annagu martigelinno (TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D, TripoSG). Meshy, Tripo, Rodin, Stability, iyo Replicate waxay ku shaqeeyaan furahaaga API-ga. Natiijooyinka ugu fiican: hal mawduuc oo si cad loo sharaxay oo leh tilmaam maaddo iyo iftiin. Habka sawirku wuxuu aqbalayaa ilaa 6 aragtiyood oo dib-u-dhiska aragtiyo badan ah. Nidaamka shaqo ee isku midka ah wuxuu diyaar u yahay wakiilada iyada oo loo marayo MCP ee /api/mcp-3d.
forge.no_3d_engine_is_reachable_on_this: Ma jiro mashiin 3D ah oo laga gaari karo meeshan la geeyay. Deji mid ka mid ah NVIDIA_API_KEY ama HF_TOKEN waddooyinka bilaashka ah, ama REPLICATE_API_TOKEN ee nidaamka shaqo ee flux → TRELLIS — Forge wuxuu qaadanayaa kii la dejiyay iyada oo aan wax isbeddel ah lagu samayn.
forge.one_click_geometric_filters_restyle_this: Shaandheeyayaal joomatari ah oo hal gujin ah. Dib u qaabee modelkan sida voxels, leben, shabag furan, ama low-poly — midabka asalka ah waa la wareejinayaa meesha qaabku ogolaado.

ibm_hello.yes_the_paid_demos_move_real_funds: Haa. Bandhigyada lacagta ah waxay lacag dhab ah ka raraan jeebkaaga — USDC, ama $THREE oo ku yaal Solana — waxayna ku degtaa Base ama Solana mainnet. ibm_hello.you_ll_need_the_phantom_wallet_on: Waxaad u baahan doontaa jeebka Phantom oo ku yaal Solana — isagoo haysta qiimaha moodelka ee USDC, ama u dhiganta $THREE, oo ku yaal Solana mainnet. Tani waxay ku bixinaysaa lacag dhab ah — qiimaha kor ku xusan — jeebkaaga; jeebku wuxuu kuu ogolaanayaa inaad doorato USDC ama $THREE. Lacag bixinta lafteedu waa saxiix aan gaas lahayn: khidmadda shabakadda waxaa bixiya fududeeyaha x402, sidaa darteed kuma kordhinayso kharashkaaga. Abuuritaanku wuxuu shaqeeyaa marka lacag bixinta la xaqiijiyo wuxuuna qaataa qiyaastii daqiiqad. Jeeb ma lihid? Forge mid bilaash ah hoos — jeeb ma jiro, fure ma jiro, lacag bixin ma jirto.

launch_week.267_8k_impressions_25_3k_engagements_9: 267.8K muuqashooyin. 25.3K isdhexgal. 9.4% heerka isdhexgalka. 5.1K booqooyinka profile-ka. 7.2K jecleysi, 1.5K dib-u-faafino, 845 jawaabo, 198 calaamado, 61 wadaagid. Saamiga jawaab-ilaa-jecleysi: 11.7% — si fiican u galay dhulka wada-hadalka tooska ah. Raacayaal la xaqiijiyay: 359. Raacaya: 11.
launch_week.3_x402_paid_endpoints: 3 x402 meelo lacag ah oo la bixiyo
launch_week.3d_character_as_claude_artifact: Jilayaal 3D ah oo ah wax soo saarka Claude
launch_week.a_real_time_3d_agent_runtime_on: Runtime wakiil 3D ah oo waqtiga dhabta ah ku shaqeeya Three.js + glTF. Wada sheekeysi bixiyeyaal badan (Claude, GPT, Groq, OpenRouter) oo leh dareen ku salaysan shucuur. Isku-dhafka boorsada Solana ee asaliga ah. Xirfadaha ganacsiga Pump.fun oo ah qalabka wakiilka. Si dib-u-injineernimo ah loo dhisay dhammaan pump-fun-agent-payments-sdk — Anchor IDL, PDAs, falanqaynta dhacdooyinka, lakabka x402 — hadda waa il la tafatiran karo. Mashiinka Solana ee qurxinta. Pump.fun saxiixaha-wadaagga abuurista lacagta. Quudinta pump.fun ee tooska ah.
launch_week.anthropic_claude_openai_gpt_groq_openrou: Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), Groq, OpenRouter — dhammaantood hal interface wada sheekeysi ah oo leh qulqul toos ah iyadoo la isticmaalayo Server-Sent Events. Wakiilku wuxuu akhriyaa dareenka isticmaalaha wuxuuna ka falceliyaa shucuur + animation. Wicitaanada shaqada, isticmaalka qalabka MCP, farshaxanada. 100% il furan.
launch_week.april_29_2026_nichxbt_posted_three_ws: Abriil 29, 2026. @nichxbt ayaa soo dhigay three.ws — madal furan oo loogu talagalay wakiillada AI-ga 3D ah ee hadla, xusuusta, jeebado haysta, oo ku shaqeeya silsiladda. 135,000 daawasho 24-kii saac ee ugu horreeyay. Isla maalintaas: xirmada npm oo shaqaynaysa, lagu qoray Diiwaanka MCP ee Anthropic, lagu qoray x402scan sidii barta lacagta lagu bixiyo, xirfadaha ganacsiga Pump.fun ee asaliga ah oo la soo saaray, Solana abuuraha cinwaanka qurxoon oo la geeyay, cod + bandhig wakiilka X Spaces.
launch_week.asymmetric_posture_is_a_signal_following: Mawqifka aan simanayn waa calaamad. Raacaya 11. Waxaa raacaya 3,675. Tiradu waxay leedahay: waxaan nahay daabace, ma nihin beerta dib-u-raacista. Raacayaasha la xaqiijiyay (359, ~10%) waxay u janjeeraan dhanka isticmaalayaasha awoodda leh — si sax ah kooxda bixisa, wax ku dhista, oo faafisa waxa aan soo saarno xiga.

news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.an_open_source_mcp_server_for_watsonx: Server MCP furan oo loogu talagalay watsonx.ai. @three-ws/ibm-watsonx-mcp wuxuu u soo bandhigayaa watsonx.ai — IBM Granite iyo nooc kasta oo akoonkaaga ku jira — macmiil kasta oo MCP ah (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor) shan qalab ahaan: sheekeysi, abuurista qoraal, xirmooyin, kala-goyn, iyo helitaanka nooca.
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.behind_the_3d_body_is_a_brain: Jirka 3D ah gadaashiisa waxaa ku jira maskax — maskaxdaasna waxay ku shaqayn kartaa IBM watsonx.ai. Isku-darku waa mid dhab ah, shaqaynaya, oo furan, iyada oo aan lahayn waddo been abuur ah. Laba lakab ayaa isku xira three.ws iyo watsonx:
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.both_layers_run_on_your_own_ibm: Labada lakabba waxay ku shaqeeyaan aqoonsigaaga IBM Cloud — furaha API-ga waxaa lagu beddelaa calaamad IAM ah oo cimrigeedu gaaban yahay, wicitaan kasta oo gunaanad ahna wuxuu ku xiran yahay mashruucaaga watsonx.ai, iyada oo aan lahayn dhexdhexaadiye three.ws ah oo u dhexeeya wakiilkaaga iyo IBM. Wakiil 3D ah oo lagu dhex-geliyay bog kasta wuxuu ku fekeri karaa IBM Granite, isagoo ku shaqeynaya mashruucaaga watsonx.ai, oo ay maamusho akoonkaaga IBM Cloud.
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.embedding_a_persistent_on_chain_3d_agent: Ku dhex-gelinta wakiil 3D ah oo joogto ah, oo silsilad ku xiran, madal kasta waa inay u fududaataa sida ku dhex-gelinta fiidiyowga YouTube. Hal calaamad <agent-3d> ah ayaa geynaysa wakiil buuxa — aan rakibitaan lahayn, aan plugin lahayn, aan app hooyo lahayn — oo lagu soo bandhigay browser kasta oo casri ah iyadoo la isticmaalayo WebGL. Waxa bogga ka soo muuqda waa jile leh waji, cod, xusuus, shucuur, iyo aqoonsi silsilad ku xiran oo ku sii jira dhammaan madallada. Ujeedada geynta aan xannibaadda lahayn: in malaayiin qof oo kale lagu soo kordhiyo AI-da jirka leh iyada oo aan midkoodna laga codsan inuu wax soo dejiyo.

news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_an_open_source_stack: three.ws waa nidaam furan (open-source stack) oo loogu talagalay wakiillada AI-da 3D ee madax-bannaan kuwaas oo si dabiici ah ugu shaqeeya biraawsarka. Summad kasta oo <agent-3d> ah waxay geynaysaa wakiil leh aqoonsi NFT ah oo Solana ah (Metaplex Core), boorsada ERC-8004 ee EVM, jidh 3D ah oo biraawsarka ku dhex jira oo ku shaqeeya WebGL iyadoo la isticmaalayo three.js, maskax LLM ah oo Claude ku shaqeysa, iyo lacag-bixinno x402 / HTTP 402 ah oo ku shaqeeya USDC oo ku yaal Base, BSC, iyo Solana.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_apache_2_0_from: three.ws waa Apache 2.0 oo dhan – daawade, wakhtiga shaqada, qandaraasyada aqoonsiga, iyo gadaal. Madalku wuxuu sidoo kale horey uga shaqeeyaa Alibaba Cloud Marketplace waxaana lagu qoray BNB Chain Dappbay, Diiwaanka Hab-maamuuska Macnaha Moodalka, iyo x402scan – AWS waxay ku biiraysaa istiraatiijiyad qaybin badan oo daruuro ah.

Madalku waxa lagu diiwaan geliyay Waddada Software-ka ee Shabakadda Shuraakada AWS (APN) isagoo ah Shuraako Tiknoolajiyadeed — magaca rasmiga ah ee iibiyeyaasha software-ka madax-bannaan ee u dhisaya alaabooyinka macaamiisha AWS.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_the_first_fully_on: three.ws waa madalkii ugu horreeyay ee wakiilka AI-da 3D ee si buuxda u shaqeeya silsiladda (on-chain) ee Shabakadda Shuraakada AWS. Summad kasta oo <agent-3d> ah oo madalku soo saarto waa jilaa madax-bannaan oo Solana-la-sameeyay, ERC-8004-boorso-leh, x402-la-bixin-karo — nidaamkaasna hadda wuxuu qayb ka yahay nidaamka shuraakada AWS.

Awoodda GPU waa xaddidaadda adag ee xawaaraha iyo faahfaahinta ay gaarto, taas oo ah xaddidaadda saxda ah ee Inception ay ka caawiso fududaynta.

Boggan waa khariidadda daacadda ah ee sida: moodooyinka ay NVIDIA martigeliso waxa ay qabtaan, GPU-yada aan annaga iska maamulno, iyo waxa aan ka barannay in aan soo saarno.
nvidia_index.what_we_run_ourselves_and_on_which: Waxa aanu ku shaqaysiino, iyo kaarka aanu ku shaqaysiino. Saf kastaa waa adeeg Cloud Run oo gaar ah oo leh siyaasaddiisa cabbirka, si shaqo texture ah oo gaabis ah aysan waligeed u sugmin shaqo rigging ah.

Moodel aad ku wareejin karto, ku xiri karto, dhaqaajin karto, oo aad qolkaaga fadhiga dhigi karto waa jawaab ka duwan sawirka mid. three.ws wuxuu jiraa si uu nooca jawaabtaas caadi uga dhigo: qaab borotokool furan, xiriiriye bilaash ah, iyo nidaam il furan oo hoos yimaada dhammaan. In lagu magacaabo OpenAI Select Partner waa taageerada lagu sii dhiso wax badan oo ka mid ah.
openai_index.collect_a_generation_that_outran_its_too: Ururi jiil ka horreeyay wicitaankiisii qalabka. Akhris-kaliya, mana isticmaasho wax quota jiil ah.

openai_index.four_live_surfaces_all_free_and_keyless: Afar dusha sare oo firfircoon, dhammaantood bilaash ah oo aan fure lahayn. Mid kasta oo ka mid ah waa il furan.

openai_index.meta_description: three.ws waa OpenAI Select Partner ka tirsan OpenAI Partner Network. Ku xir server-ka bilaashka ah ee three.ws 3D Studio MCP ChatGPT oo amar u beddel moodel 3D ah oo is dhexgal ah, la xiriiri karo, AR-diyaar ah oo ku dhex jira wadahadalka.

openai_index.none_no_key_no_account_no_wallet: Midna. Ma jiro fure, ma jiro akoon, ma jiro boorso.
openai_index.one_call_generate_the_mesh_and_rig: Hal wicitaan: abuur mesh-ka oo ku xir, gadaasha albaab bini'aadan-u-eg.
openai_index.reload_a_persona_in_a_fresh_session: Dib u soo shub shakhsiyad fadhi cusub. Aqoonsigu waa awoodda.
openai_index.streamable_http_json_rpc_over_post: HTTP la daawan karo (JSON-RPC oo POST ah)
openai_index.the_same_free_lane_as_a_rest: Waddada bilaashka ah ee la mid ah dusha sare ee Ficilada REST ee GPT-ga gaarka ah ee "three.ws 3D Studio", oo leh albaab badbaado oo da'da 13+ ah iyo jawaabo nadiif ah oo dukaanka ah. Wuxuu daboolaa qorshayaasha aan lahayn taageero xiriiriye.
openai_index.three_ws_has_been_named_an_openai: three.ws waxaa loo magacaabay OpenAI Select Partner gudaha OpenAI Partner Network. Xiriiriyaha bilaashka ah ee 3D Studio ee madal-ka wuxuu jumlad u beddelaa moodel 3D ah oo is dhexgal ah, oo leh qaab-dhismeed oo ku dhex muuqda wadahadalka, ka dibna wuu ku xiraa, wuu dhaqaajiyaa, oo wuxuu dhigaa qolkaaga AR. Ma jiro fure, ma jiro akoon, ma jiro kharash.
openai_index.three_ws_is_an_independent_member_of: three.ws waa xubin madax-bannaan oo ka tirsan OpenAI Partner Network, heerka Select. Boggan wuxuu sharxayaa alaabada three.ws ee ku xiran baraha OpenAI; ma aha badeecad OpenAI ah mana ansixin OpenAI marka laga reebo magaca shuraakada la muujiyay. OpenAI, ChatGPT, iyo calaamadda OpenAI Partner Network waa calaamado ganacsi oo ay leedahay OpenAI. Wax badan ka baro shabakadda openai.com/business/partners.
openai_index.turn_a_generated_avatar_into_a_persisten: Avatar la abuuray ka dhig mid joogto ah, magac leh, oo aqoonsi ahaan dib u soo shubma.
openai_index.what_we_ship_on_openai_surfaces: Waxa aanu ku soo bandhigno baraha OpenAI.

oracle.every_oracle_armed_agent_action_in_real: Tallaabo kasta oo wakiilka Oracle-ku hubaysan uu sameeyo waqtiga dhabta ah — waxa ay iibsanayaan goobta ganacsiga ee madax-bannaan, waxa ku dhammaaday guulo, iyo waxa aan ku dhammaan. Tallaabooyin la ekaysiiyay iyo kuwo toos ah oo isku jira.
oracle.every_scored_coin_as_a_sphere_in: Lacag kasta oo la dhibceeyay oo ah goob bannaan 3D ah. Baaxad = dhibcaha kalsoonida. Midab = heer. Jiid si aad u wareegto, kor u rog si aad u soo dhowayso. Guji goob kasta si aad u furto faahfaahinta kalsoonideeda oo dhan.

Kani waa asalka awooda siiya dhibcaha kalsoonida.
oracle.meta_description: Oracle waxa ay isku-dhafaysaa cidda wax iibsanaysa, sida ay wax u iibsanayaan, waxa uu yahay qadaadiicda, iyo sida ay u socoto hal dhibic go'aan toos ah oo loogu talagalay bilaw kasta oo pump.fun ah — oo u ogolaanaysa wakiilkaaga AI-ga 3D inuu ku dhaqmo ciyaaraha go'aanka ugu sarreeya. oracle_docs.oracle_is_an_analytics_and_automation_to: Oracle waa qalab falanqayn iyo otomaatig ah. Dhibcaha go'aan qaadashada, calaamadaha, iyo ficillada wakiilku waa kuwo macluumaad ah. Ganacsiga tooska ah wuxuu halis gelinayaa lacag dhab ah; marka hore ku dayo, si adag u xaddid, oo lambar kasta u qaado sidii hal xog oo ka mid ah kuwa badan.
oracle_docs.oracle_owns_five_tables_classified_story: Oracle waxay leedahay shan miis: oracle_narrative (sheeko la kala saaray + faafitaan), oracle_conviction (kaydka go'aanka tooska ah, hal saf mint kasta), oracle_conviction_history (taxanaha wakhtiga dhibcaha, oo la qoro kaliya marka ay isbeddel ku yimaado ≥3 dhibcood, kaydinta 72 saacadood), oracle_agent_watch (habaynta wakiilka hubaysan), iyo oracle_watch_actions (buugga ficillada). Tiirarka oo dhan waxay ku jiraan qaabka xogta.
oracle_docs.oracle_owns_five_tables_the_verdict_cach: Oracle waxay leedahay shan miis. Kaydka go'aanku waa wadnaha; inta kale waa taariikh, habayn, iyo buugga ficillada.
oracle_docs.oracle_reads_every_pump_fun_launch_the: Oracle waxay akhridaa bilaw kasta oo pump.fun ah isla marka uu soo baxo waxayna ka jawaabtaa hal su'aal: immisa go'aan qaadasho ayay xogta silsiladdu dhab ahaan taageertaa? Waxay isku darsataa afar akhris oo madaxbannaan — yaa iibsanaya, sidee loo qaabeeyey bilawga, sheeko noocee ah ayay ku socotaa, iyo sidee ayay u socotaa — hal dhibic oo hufan 0–100 ah, ka dibna waxay u ogolaataa wakiilkaaga 3D inuu ku dhaqmo ciyaaraha ka gudba heerkaaga. Kani waa tixraaca dhammaystiran: aragtida, xisaabta saxda ah, xogta, caddaynta, API-ga, xaddidaadaha, iyo halka ay ku xigto.
oracle_docs.oracle_reads_from_a_separate_full_covera: Oracle waxay ka akhridaa maskax xogeed dhammaystiran oo gaar ah halkii ay ka taaban lahayd silsiladda lafteeda. Maskaxdu waxay qaadataa pump.fun waxayna ilaalisaa garaafka sumcadda; Oracle waxay ururisaa, kala saartaa, oo isku darsataa. Kala soociddu waa waxa ka dhigaya dhibcaha mid saafi ah, oo degdeg ah.
oracle_docs.oracle_s_wager_is_that_a_transparent: Sharadka Oracle waa in isku-darka hufan, ee la hagaajiyay ee yaa / sidee / maxay / dhaqaaq uu ka fiican yahay dareenka caloosha iyo tilmaame kasta oo keli ah, sababtoo ah hababka fashilku waa kuwo madaxbannaan. Sheeko weyn (MAXAY) ma badbaadin karto bilaw uu horay u iibiyay horumariyuhu (SIDEE). Lacag badan oo boorsooyin lacag-caqli ah (YAA) wax yar ayay ka dhigan tahay haddii ay horay u goynayaan (sidoo kale YAA). Isku-darka akhrisyada madaxbannaan wuxuu baabi'iyaa buuqa wuxuuna soo saaraa bilawga naadirka ah ee ay dhammaan dhidibadu isku raacsan yihiin.

Lacag si dhab ah u raacaysa cinwaanka maanta ayaa loo aqoonsadaa sidaas waxaana la siiyaa dhibco sare. oracle_docs.wilson_1927_probable_inference_the_law_o: Wilson (1927), Probable inference, the law of succession, and statistical inference — kala-baxa dhibcaha. Brier (1950), Verification of forecasts expressed in terms of probability. Platt (1999), natiijooyinka suurtagalka ah ee SVMs (Platt scaling). Zadrozny & Elkan (2002), cabbirka isotonic. Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana (2005), Predicting good probabilities with supervised learning.
oracle_docs.wilson_interval_the_95_score_interval_on: Kala-baxa Wilson: kala-baxa dhibcaha 95% ee heerka guusha heer kasta/qayb kasta (ka soo jeeda faahfaahinta caddaynta), sax ah marka n uu yar yahay oo ku xiran [0,1].
oracle_docs.win_loss_isn_t_known_until_a: Guul/khasaare lama oga ilaa lacagta ay xaliso, sidaa darteed tijaabada hore waxay had iyo jeer ka dambeysaa xilligan. Daaqadaha dhowaan waa kuwo khafiif ah oo xargaha kalsoonidoodu waa ballaaran yihiin — bogguna wuxuu muujiyaa ballaca halkii uu ka qarin lahaa.
oracle_docs.win_rate_by_tier_with_honest_error: Heerka guusha heer kasta, oo leh xariiqyo khalad oo daacad ah.
oracle_docs.win_rate_by_tier_with_wilson_cis: Heerka guusha heer kasta oo ay la socdaan Wilson CIs, jaranjarada cabbirka, Brier, iyo soo koobidda cidhifka. Shaandheeyayaasha: muddo, heer, shabakad.
oracle_docs.win_the_coin_graduated_or_its_peak: Guul — qadaadiicdu way qalinjabisay, ama heerkeeda ugu sarreeya ee isku-dhufashadu gaadhay ≥2× qadaadiic aan la dhicin oo aan lagu calaamadin wax ka hooseeya nus gelitaan.
oracle_docs.with_no_signal_yet_it_returns_too: Iyadoo aan weli wax calaamad ah jirin, waxay soo celisaa "goor hore," iyadoo tiirka ka dhigaysa mid dhexdhexaad ah halkii ay ka abuuri lahayd xawaare aan jirin.

partners.deployed_on_aws_infrastructure_with_mark: Waxaa lagu rakibay kaabayaasha AWS iyadoo suuqa (Marketplace) laga heli karo. partners.every_agent_gets_a_verifiable_on_chain: Wakiil kasta wuxuu helayaa aqoonsi la xaqiijin karo oo silsiladda ku jira. Madal-kaagu wuxuu qayb ka noqonayaa dhaqaale wakiil oo aan ogolaansho u baahnayn.

partners.three_ws_3d_agent_identity_and_x402: Aqoonsiga wakiilka 3D ee three.ws iyo hababka lacag bixinta ee x402 waxay isku xirmaan IBM watsonx iyo IBM Granite. Wakiiladu waxay ku shaqeeyaan moodooyinka AI-ga shirkadaha iyagoo ilaalinaya aqoonsiga silsiladda ku jira oo fulinaya lacag bixinno yaryar oo dhab ah — dhammaantood hal profile wakiil ah.

sign_language.a_signer_spells_names_and_loanwords_and: Qofka saxiixa wuxuu higgaadiyaa magacyada iyo ereyada amaahda ah wuxuuna saaxiixaa wax kasta oo kale. Erayadan waxay leeyihiin calaamado dhab ah oo ku jira erayada avatar-ka: qaab gacan, meel jidhka ah, iyo dhaqdhaqaaq, hal gacan ama labadaba. Dooro mid si aad u daawato. Wax kasta oo kale oo jumlad ah wali waa la far-higgaadiyaa.
sign_language.all_26_asl_letter_handshapes_plus_the: Dhammaan 26-ka qaab gacan ee xarfaha ASL iyo tirooyinka 0-9, oo ay la socdaan J iyo Z oo la raadraacay iyo boodboodka xarafka labanlaabma. sign_language.best_results_good_light_hand_in_frame: Natiijooyinka ugu fiican: iftiin wanaagsan, gacan ku jirta jir, hal xaraf markiiba. Tirooyinka iyo alifbeetada A-Z oo dhan waa la taageeraa.
sign_language.click_start_fingerspell_a_word_at_your: Guji bilow, far-higgaadi erey kamaradaada, ka dibna jooji. Browser-kaagu wuxuu fiidiyowga u beddelaa calaamado gacan iyo jidh oo gudaha ah; kaliya isku-duwayaashaas ayaa loo diraa aqoonsiga. Far-higgaadinta webcam-ku ma dhammaystirna (filo xaraf khaldan oo aan caadi ahayn), markaa dib u eeg qoraalka ka hor intaadan ku kalsoonaan.
sign_language.fingerspell_into_your_webcam_and_the_ai: Farahaaga ku qor webcam-kaaga oo AI-du waxay u akhrinaysaa qoraal: calaamadaha muhiimka ah waxaa laga soo saaraa qalabkaaga, sidaa darteed fiidyowgu marnaba kama baxo mashiinkaaga. Demo-ga hoose wuxuu shaqeysiiyaa aqoonsadaha isku midka ah.
sign_language.honest_scope_words_with_a_sign_are: Baaxadda dhabta ah: erayada leh calaamad waa la calaamadeeyaa, inta kale oo dhan waxaa faraha lagu qoraa xaraf xaraf. Calaamadaha waxaa la isku xiraa siday erayada Ingiriisiga u kala horreeyaan, taasoo ah Ingiriis la calaamadeeyay, ma aha naxwaha ASL: ASL-ka dhabta ah wuxuu dib u habayn ku sameeyaa jumladaha, wuxuu ficillada ku beddelaa meel bannaan, wuxuuna naxwaha ku muujiyaa wejiga. Erayada kor ku xusan waa bilow waxaana loogu talagalay inay koraan. Akhri faahfaahinta buuxda.
sign_language.meta_description: Avatars-ka three.ws waxay ku calaamadeeyaan Luqadda Calaamadaha Maraykanka. Farahaaga ku qor eray ama tiro kasta, hel jawaabo sheeko oo calaamadeysan, oo dib ugu calaamadee AI-da adigoo isticmaalaya webcam-kaaga: wareegga oo dhan, si toos ah 3D ah.

sign_language.meta_twitter_description: Avatars-ka ku calaamadeeya ASL: faraha lagu qoro, jawaabaha sheekada ee calaamadeysan, iyo gelinta calaamadaha webcam-ka, si toos ah 3D ah.
sign_language.three_ws_avatars_fingerspell_any_word_or: Avatars-ka three.ws waxay faraha ku qoraan eray ama tiro kasta oo ASL ah, waxay calaamadeeyaan jawaab kasta oo sheeko ah, waxayna dib uga akhriyaan calaamadeyntaada webcam-ka. Wadahadalka oo dhan, labada jiho, 3D ah oo ku shaqeeya biraawsarka.

spatial_mcp_index.a_third_party_mcp_server_that_returns: Server-ka MCP ee dhinac saddexaad oo soo celiya { url, previewImage } wuxuu noqonayaa mid waafaqsan adabtar yar — eeg docs/spatial-mcp. Renderer kasta oo fahma qaabkan (kan oo ay ku jiraan) ayaa markaa soo bandhigaya. Ma jiro lacag-bixin, boorso, ama lacag-caddaan ah oo ka muuqata qaabka ama renderer-ka.
spatial_mcp_index.checker_lede: Ku dhaji natiijada qalabka hoos. Xogta waafaqsan ayaa hoos ka muuqata; kuwa aan la isticmaali karin waxay helayaan dib-u-dhacii loogu talagalay, waligoodna ma aha shaashad madhan.
spatial_mcp_index.meta_description: Renderer-ka tixraaca ee qaabka farshaxanka furan ee Spatial MCP — 3D ahaan nooc jawaab celin wada hadal ah oo asal ah MCP.
spatial_mcp_index.meta_og_description: Halbeegga furan ee soo celinta muuqaal 3D ah oo nool, is-dhexgal ah oo ah natiijo qalab MCP heer sare ah, oo leh renderer tixraac ah oo aan lahayn qaab-dhismeed kaas oo soo bandhiga farshaxan kasta oo waafaqsan — oo ay ku jiraan kuwa laga beddelay qalab kale.

symphony.meta_description: Symphony-ga Wakiilku wuxuu dhaqaalaha wakiilka three.ws ee tooska ah u beddelaa muusig abuuris ah. Lacag bixin kasta, ganacsi, bilaw iyo heer kor u qaadis kasta oo ka dhacda madaldu waxay u ciyaartaa sidii qoraal la isku daray oo waqtiga dhabta ah ah. Dhageyso dhaqaalaha mashiinka.
symphony.meta_og_description: Dhaqaalaha wakiilka, oo si toos ah loogu ciyaaro muusig ahaan. Dhacdo kasta oo dhab ah oo madaldu waxay noqotaa qoraal la isku daray: lacag bixintu way soo jiidataa, iibsiga waaweynku waxay u degtaa sidii bass, wakiilada cusubna way dhawaaqaan. Duub muuqaal gaaban oo la wadaag.
symphony.meta_twitter_description: Dhaqaalaha wakiilka, oo si toos ah loogu ciyaaro muusig ahaan. Dhacdo kasta oo dhab ah oo madaldu waxay noqotaa qoraal la isku daray waqtiga dhabta ah.

symphony.sound_only_starts_when_you_press_play: Codku wuxuu bilaabmaa oo keliya marka aad riixdo ciyaar; waxba si otomaatig ah uma ciyaaraan. Qulqulka dhacdooyinka isku midka ah ayaa quudiya Money Pulse iyo calaamadeeyaha goobta oo dhan. Wakiil kastaa wuxuu hayaa mawduuc deggan iyo booska stereo, si kuwa joogtada ah loogu aqoonsado dhegta. Dul saar khad kasta oo dhibcaha ah oo riix solo si aad u aamusiso inta kale ee madaldu oo aad u dhageysato ka qaybgalahaas oo keliya; xiriirku wuu sii ahaanayaa mid la wadaagi karo. Ma doorbidaysaa tirooyinka qoraalada? Dashboard-ka dhaqaalaha ayaa ku daboolaya.
symphony.space_plays_and_pauses_click_a_voice: <kbd>Space</kbd> wuu ciyaaraa oo hakad galaa. Guji cod hoose si aad u aamusiso.
symphony.the_agent_economy_played_live_as_music: Dhaqaalaha wakiilka, oo si toos ah loogu ciyaaro muusig ahaan. Dhacdo kasta oo dhab ah oo ka dhacda three.ws waxay noqotaa qoraal la isku daray isla marka ay dhacdo: lacag bixintu way soo jiidataa, iibsiga waaweynku waxay u degtaa sidii bass, wakiilada cusubna way dhawaaqaan, diidmada badbaadaduna waxay u dhex martaa sidii iswaafaq la'aan. Waxba lama duubin hore mana la jilcin. Waxaad dhageysaneysaa mashiinno ganacsi samaynaya.

Ma jiro shaandhayn, ma jiraan khiyaamo celcelis ah — tirooyinka cinwaanka hoose iyo jaantusyada hoose waxay ka yimaadeen shaashadda isku mid ah.
three_ws_launch_week.reputation_markets_staking_on_agents_sig: Suuqyada sumcadda oo lagu shubayo (staking) taariikhaha ficillada la saxiixay ee wakiillada, lacagaha xuquuqda xirfadaha EIP-7710 oo la siiyo qorayaasha xirfadaha wicitaan kasta, iyo lacag bixinta madax-bannaan ee wakiil-ilaa-wakiil iyadoo la isticmaalayo boorsooyinka saxiixayaasha la wakiishay.
three_ws_launch_week.the_custom_element_loads_lazily_on_inter: Curiyaha gaarka ah ee <agent-3d> wuxuu si tartiib ah u shaqeeyaa marka la isku xiro, wuxuuna taageeraa shan nooc oo widget ah (turntable, gallery-ga animations-ka, wakiil hadlaya, ERC-8004 kaarka baasaboorka, dalxiiska hotspot-ka), wuxuuna soo saaraa xogta Open Graph iyo oEmbed si isku xirayaashu ay u soo bandhigaan horudhacyo qani ah. Isticmaalka fudud ee Widget Studio wuxuu soo saaraa koodhka lagu dhejiyo (embed code) ee la koobiyayn karo oo la dhejin karo /studio. Xirmooyinka CDN ee noocyada kala duwan leh waxaa laga helaa /agent-3d/x.y.z/.
three_ws_launch_week.the_google_cloud_announcement_was_the_si: Ku dhawaaqistii Google Cloud waxay ahayd qoraalkii ugu xiisaha badnaa toddobaadka (~6.9K aragtiyo, 263 jecel, 24 dib-u-qorid) iyo kaabayaasha daruuriga ah ee taageeraya wajiga xiga ee madasha.
three_ws_launch_week.the_inside_the_3d_agent_web_podcast: Qaybta podcast-ka ee “Inside The 3D Agent Web” waxaa lagu daabacay Amazon Music iyo blog-ga la socda ee “Beyond Chatbots: Why Your AI Agent Needs a 3D Body” waxaa lagu faafiyay nidaamka Spotify-on-chain. Laba meelood oo kale oo wax lagu faafiyo, hal toddobaad oo kale.
three_ws_launch_week.the_platform_shipped_as_a_partner_listin: Madasha waxaa loo soo saaray sidii liis iskaashi oo ku taal Alibaba Cloud, oo ah kanaalkayagii ugu horreeyay ee qaybinta suuqa daruuriga ah. Tweet-kii daahfurka ee la xiriiray wuxuu soo jiitay ~7.1K aragtiyo kaligiis.
three_ws_launch_week.the_roadmap_closes_the_gap_from_use: Khariidadda jidku waxay buuxinaysaa farqiga u dhexeeya “isticmaal farshaxaniste 3D ah” iyo “qaado selfie”. Afar waji, oo si buuxda loogu qeexay README-ga dadweynaha.
three_ws_launch_week.the_runtime_drives_a_claude_tool_loop: Runtime-ku wuxuu wadaa wareegga qalabka Claude oo leh ilaa siddeed isku-celis wareeg kasta iyo lix qalab oo ku dhex jira (wave, lookAt, play_clip, setExpression, speak, remember). Lakabka Dareenka (Empathy Layer) ma aha mashiin gobol (state machine) — waa isku-darka miisaaman oo joogto ah oo shan dareen ah (farxad, walaac, xiiso, naxariis, dulqaad), mid walbana wuxuu leeyahay nus-nolol gooni ah oo hoos u dhac ah, isagoo wada morph targets-ka avatar-ka’ iyo qaabka madaxa daqiiqad kasta. Xirfaduhu waa xirmooyin isku-dhafan oo lagu qaybin karo IPFS, Arweave, ama HTTP. Xusuusta waxay ku salaysan tahay faylal oo leh afar hab oo kaydin ah (maxalli, IPFS, IPFS-siraysan, midna).
three_ws_launch_week.the_three_ws_x_community_is_the: Bulshada three.ws X waa dhagaystayaasha la isugu keenay — horumariyayaal, dhisayaal xiisaynaya wakiillada, iyo koox dad ah oo si toos ah ula socda. Waa meesha ay ka iman doonaan hirka xiga ee milkiilayaasha wakiillada.
three_ws_launch_week.three_selfies_left_center_right_gpu_back: Saddex sawir-qaad (bidix, dhexe, midig), dib-u-dhiska wajiga ee aragti-badan, oo ay taageerayso GPU, iyo avatar la diyaariyay, oo la dhaqaajin karo oo loo sameeyay sidii token ERC-8004 oo qabyo ah wax ka yar lixdan ilbiriqsi. Isticmaalka qabashada ee mobilka-ugu-horreeya oo leh albaabada tayada ee waqtiga-dhabta ah.
three_ws_launch_week.three_solidity_contracts_make_up_the_erc: Saddex heshiis oo Solidity ah ayaa ka kooban hirgelinta ERC-8004: IdentityRegistry (tokens-ka wakiilka ERC-721 oo leh saxiixayaal EIP-712 oo la wakiishay), ReputationRegistry (jawaab celin dib-u-eegis oo la saxiixay, oo si celcelis ah loogu xisaabiyay silsiladda), iyo ValidationRegistry (cadaymaha ansixiyaha ee caddaymaha ka baxsan silsiladda). Dhacdo kasta oo speak, remember, iyo skill-done ah waa la saxiixaa oo la diiwaan geliyaa. Solana waxa ay soo saartaa mid la mid ah iyadoo la isticmaalayo Metaplex Core NFTs oo lagu daray cadaymaha SPL Memo ee la saxiixay — qaab isku mid ah, looma baahna barnaamij gaar ah.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_an_open_source_browser: three.ws waa madal wakiilka AI 3D ah oo il furan, oo ku shaqeysa biraawsarka. Waxaan soo saarnay dhammaan xirmooyinka — daawade, wakhtiga shaqada wakiilka, aqoonsiga silsiladda, server-ka OAuth 2.1, barta dhamaadka MCP, iyo qaybta shabakadda ee la gelin karo — ka dibna waxaan daawanay bilawga oo hirgalay. Waa kan waxa dhacay.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_organized_as_four_communicat: three.ws waxa loo habeeyay afar lakab oo isgaadhsiinaya, oo lagu daray backend iyo xirmo heshiisyo ah. Lakab kasta wuxuu ku jiraa wax-soo-saar three.ws waxaana loo soo saaraa qayb ka mid ah kaydka il-furan. Waa kan liiska.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_published_as_on_registry: three.ws waxa loo daabacay sidii io.github.nirholas/three.ws oo ku taal registry.modelcontextprotocol.io waxaana laga heli karaa hagaha la xushay ee PulseMCP’. Macmiil kasta oo MCP-ogaal ah (oo ay ku jiraan Claude Desktop) wuu isku xirmi karaa oo wuu wadi karaa avatars-ka iyadoo la isticmaalayo JSON-RPC.
three_ws_launch_week.vercel_functions_on_neon_postgres_cloudf: Shaqooyinka Vercel ee Neon Postgres, Cloudflare R2, iyo Upstash Redis. Server OAuth 2.1 oo buuxa (RFC 6749 + PKCE, diiwaangelinta firfircoon ee RFC 7591, ka noqoshada RFC 7009, kormeerka RFC 7662, helitaanka RFC 8414, helitaanka kheyraadka la ilaaliyo ee RFC 9728). Server MCP ah oo ku shaqeeya HTTP — 759 xariiq, JSON-RPC 2.0, oo ku qoran Diiwaanka Rasmiga ah ee Model Context Protocol sida io.github.nirholas/three.ws. Shaqooyinka Cron ee gurguuriyaha ERC-8004, tusiyaha wakiilnimada EIP-7710, fulinta istaraatiijiyadda DCA, iyo isdiiwaangelinta silsiladda ee soo noqnoqda.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Sawir-qaadista WebGL 2.0 oo leh taageero buuxda oo glTF 2.0 / GLB ah: Cadaadiska juqraafiyada Draco, cadaadiska texture-ka KTX2, hagaajinta mesh-ka Meshopt, khariidadaha deegaanka ee HDR, agabka PBR, animation-ka maqaarka, morph targets, iyo kamaradaha ku dhex jira. Xaqiijinta waa heer-xariiq iyadoo la isticmaalayo Khronos gltf-validator. Soo-dejinta jiid-iyo-tuur, OrbitControls oo leh wareeg toos ah oo la habayn karo, iyo dat.GUI waqtiga-dhabta ah oo loogu talagalay hagaajinta tooska ah.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: Daawade WebGL, wakhtiga shaqada wakiilka LLM, heshiisyada aqoonsiga ERC-8004, server-ka OAuth 2.1, barta dhamaadka MCP, iyo qaybta shabakadda <agent-3d> — wax kasta oo aad kor ku soo akhriday. Wuxuu ku nool yahay three.ws maanta.

trading.every_surface_sub: Nidaamku wuu ka weyn yahay hal bog. Halkan waa khariidadda oo dhan.
trading.fleet_vitals_sub: Si toos ah uga akhri shaqaalaha shaqaynaya. Haddii tiro halkan ku taal ay duugowday, ciidanku waa duugoobay.
trading.hero_sub: Ciidan wakiilo AI ah ayaa ka ganacsada qadaadiic cusub oo laga soo saaray boorsooyinkooda Solana, iyagoo raacaya sharciyo aysan ka bixi karin. Gelitaan kasta waa la dhibceeyaa, boos kasta waxaa lagu cabbiraa miisaaniyad khatar adag, iyo buuxin kasta waxaa saxiixa furaha wakiilka oo lagu xaqiijin karo silsiladda. Boggan waa qolka xakamaynta: waxa ciidanku samaynayo hadda, sida ay u go'aansadaan, iyo halka ay ku xigaan.
trading.meta_description: Qolka xakamaynta ee three.ws ganacsiga madaxbannaan: xaaladda ciidanka oo toos ah, dhibcaha wakiilka, habka gelitaanka-ilaa-bixitaanka oo dhan, iyo dhammaan dusha ganacsiga hal meel. Boorsooyin dhab ah, buuxin dhab ah, oo lagu xaqiijin karo silsiladda.
trading.meta_og_description: Xaaladda guud ee ciidanka oo toos ah, dhibcaha wakiilka, iyo dhammaan meelaha ganacsiga madaxbannaan hal meel.
trading.meta_twitter_description: Xaaladda guud ee ciidanka oo toos ah, dhibcaha wakiilka, iyo dhammaan meelaha ganacsiga madaxbannaan hal meel.
trading.pipeline_sub: Gelitaan kasta wuxuu maraa albaabada isku mid ah, siday u kala horreeyaan. Albaab aan caddayn karin in lacagtu badbaado tahay wuxuu joojiyaa ganacsiga halkii uu qiyaas lahaa.
trading.rail_budget_body: Baaxadda ganacsi kasta, kharashka maalinlaha ah, iyo tirada ugu badan ee boosaska isku mar ah waa xadad la hubiyo ka hor inta aan la baahin wax kasta.
trading.rail_custody_body: Wakiiladu waxay ku ganacsadaan furayaashooda gaarka ah iyagoo maraya waddo hayn ah oo la hubiyay. Akhriso qaabka haynta.
trading.rail_kill_body: Mid guud iyo mid wakiil kasta u gaar ah. Marka la shido, wuxuu joojiyaa gelitaannada cusub isla markiiba, milkiiluhuna mar walba wuu kala bixi karaa boorsada.
trading.rail_moonbag: Weligaa ha ka bixin si buuxda mid guulaystay
trading.rail_moonbag_body: Siyaasadda ciidanku waxay haysaa qayb ugu yaraan ah oo ka mid ah boos guulaystay, si aan wicitaan wanaagsan si buuxda loogu iibin goor hore.
trading.rail_risk_body: Ganacsiga lacagaha cusub ee la bilaabay wuxuu lumin karaa booska oo dhan. Akhriso aqoonsiga khatarta ka hor intaadan waxba hubayn.
trading.rail_stop_body: Istaraatiijiyad kasta oo hubaysan waxay wadataa joojin-khasaare, oo lagu dhaqan geliyo xaddidaad xog-ururin ah. Istaraatiijiyad aan mid lahayn ma jiri karto.
trading.safety_rails_sub: Kuwan waxaa lagu dhaqan geliyaa koodhka iyo xog-ururinta, ma aha degdeg. Wakiil ma doodi karo si uu uga gudbo midkoodna.
trading.scoreboard_sub: Faa'iidada iyo khasaaraha dhabta ah ee wakiil kasta, ganacsiyada la xiray oo kaliya. Boosaska furan weligood looma tiriyo faa'iido.
trading.step_exit_body: Qiyaastii laba jeer gelitaanka, wakiilku wuxuu iibiyaa wax ku filan si uu u soo celiyo saamigiisa wuxuuna inta kale u hayaa sidii "moon bag" oo ku xiran joojin raacsan. Joojin-khasaare adag ayaa ku guulaysata khilaaf kasta, joojin waqtiyaysanna waxay xirtaa wax kasta oo aan meelna gaarin.
trading.step_firewall_body: Iibsi iyo iibin dhab ah oo wareeg ah ayaa lagu daydaa silsiladda ka hor inta aan waxba la baahin. Haddii iibku dib u noqdo, lacagta lama bixin karo, ganacsigana waa la joojiyaa. Awoodda abuurista iyo joojinta ayaa lagu hubiyaa isla mar.
trading.step_score_body: Lacagta waxaa lagu shaandheeyaa iyadoo lagu salaynayo xadka suuqa, taariikhda abuuraha, baraha bulshada, iyo hantida xigashada. Wakiilada qaar waxay raacaan xeerar go'an, kuwa kalena waxay go'aanka u dhiibaan moodel luqadeed, dhibcaha sare ku qoran ayaa ah waxa muranka xaliya.
trading.step_signal_body: Bilaabid, dalab khidmad ah oo ugu horreeya, iskutallaab oracle ah, ama qalinjabin ayaa soo gaarta quudka. Shaqaaluhu wuxuu quudka u hayaa mid furan, si uu isla markiiba uga jawaabo halkii uu jadwalka ku xirnaan lahaa.
trading.step_size_body: Baaxadda boosku waxay ka timaaddaa miisaaniyadda wakiilka ee ganacsi kasta, waxaana xaddidaya miisaaniyaddiisa maalinlaha ah iyo xadka boosaska furan. Ilaaliyaha kharashka iyo siyaasadda boorsada waxaa lagu dhaqan geliyaa koodhka, sidaa darteed ma jiro habayn ballaarin kara.

x402_stripe.a_live_catalog_of_endpoints_an_agent: Buug toos ah oo dhibco ah oo wakiil – ama bini'aadam – uu isla markiiba socodsiin karo oo uu ku bixin karo, laguna dejiyay silsiladda USDC iyadoo la isticmaalayo borotokoolka x402. Furayaal ma jiraan, isdiiwaangelin ma jirto, SDK la baranayo ma jirto. Eeg qaab-dhismeedka, buuxi galalka, guji Run.
x402_stripe.agents_pay_autonomously_with_x402_fetch_: Wakiiladu waxay si madax-bannaan u bixiyaan iyagoo isticmaalaya @x402/fetch ama gaadiidka MCP — ma jiro UI boorsada, ma jiro furaha API. Alaabada dib loo soo dejisan karo waxay taageeraan dib u gelitaanka Sign-In-With-Wallet si iibsadayaashu aysan marnaba laba jeer u bixin hantida isku mid ah.
x402_stripe.check_agent_availability_0_001_usdc: <!-- 1. Load once --> <script type="module" src="https://three.ws/x402.js"></script> <!-- 2. Any button becomes a paid call --> <button data-x402-endpoint="https://three.ws/api/x402/symbol-availability?ticker=AGENT" data-x402-merchant="three.ws" data-x402-action="Check ticker availability"> Hubi helitaanka AGENT · $0.001 USDC </button>
x402_stripe.const_result_payment_await_window_x402_p: const { result, payment } = await window.X402.pay({ endpoint: '/api/x402/symbol-availability', method: 'GET', body: { ticker: 'AGENT' }, merchant: 'Acme', }); // payment.transaction → hash-ka wax kala iibsiga silsiladda // payment.payer → boorsada iibsadaha // result → jawaabta JSON ee dhibicdaada
x402_stripe.every_endpoint_below_is_live_click_one: Dhibic kasta oo hoose waa mid toos ah. Guji mid si aad u eegto qaab-dhismeedkeeda oo aad ugu socodsiiso lacag bixin dhab ah oo silsiladda ah.
x402_stripe.live_on_base_solana_mainnet: Toos uga shaqeeya Base & Solana mainnet
x402_stripe.meta_description: Buug toos ah oo API-yo lacag-bixin-hal-wac ah, lagu dejiyay silsiladda USDC iyadoo la isticmaalayo borotokoolka x402. Raadi, eeg qaab-dhismeedka, oo ku socodsii dhibic kasta hal gujis — furayaal ma jiraan, isdiiwaangelin ma jirto.
x402_stripe.meta_og_description: Liis toos ah, oo la raadin karo oo ah API-yada lacag-bixinta-hal-wac. Eeg qaab-dhismeedka oo ku shaqee meel kasta hal gujis. Dejin silsilad-dhexdeed ah oo USDC ah oo ku salaysan Base iyo Solana.

x402_stripe.paste_one_line_into_your_add_to: Ku dheji hal xariiq <madaxa>aga. Ku dar data-x402-endpoint badhan kasta. Modal-ku wuxuu maamulaa boorsada, caqabada 402, iyo dejinta.

API-yada lacag-bixinta-hal-wac,
hal gujis uun ayay jiraan.
x402_stripe.payai_or_coinbase_cdp_verifies_and_broad: PayAI ama Coinbase CDP waxay xaqiijinayaan oo ku baahinayaan silsilad-dhexdeed. Meel-dhamaadkaagu wuu shaqeeyaa oo natiijada dib ayuu u soo diraa.
x402_stripe.phantom_for_solana_metamask_or_coinbase_: Phantom oo loogu talagalay Solana, MetaMask ama Coinbase oo loogu talagalay Base. Waxaan dhisnaa wareejinta SPL ama oggolaanshaha EIP-3009. Hal gujis.
x402_stripe.same_settlement_driven_from_javascript_t: Dejin isku mid ah, oo laga maamulo JavaScript. Ballanqaadku wuxuu ku xalliyaa JSON-ka meel-dhamaadkaaga iyo rasiidka dejinta.
x402_stripe.the_modal_opens_probes_your_endpoint_par: Modal-ku wuu furmaa, wuxuu baaraa meel-dhamaadkaaga, wuxuu falanqeeyaa caqabada 402, wuxuuna muujiyaa qiimaha saxda ah iyo shabakada.
x402_stripe.x402_is_http_402_payment_required_with: x402 waa HTTP 402 Payment Required, oo leh manifest. Drop-in-ku wuxuu maamulaa dhammaan habka — adigu waligaa ma aragtid.

x402_studio.meta_description: Stripe-ka x402. Deji qiimaha, boorsooyinka lacag-bixinta iyo wakiilada, alaabada, amniga, CORS, sadaqada iyo deeqaha isku-darka ah — oo daabac dukaanka jiid-iyo-tuur ah. Dhammaantood waxaa lagu dejiyay silsilad-dhexdeed USDC ah.
x402_studio.meta_og_description: Maamul ganacsi x402 lacag ah: boorsooyinka wakiilada, alaabada, dukaan jiid-iyo-tuur ah, sadaqo + deeqo isku-darka ah. Dejin silsilad-dhexdeed USDC ah.
x402_studio.meta_twitter_description: Qalabka ganacsadaha si loo maamulo ganacsi x402 lacag ah: alaabada iyo qiimaha, boorsooyinka lacag-bixinta iyo wakiilada, diris/helid USDC dhab ah oo leh xallinta SNS .sol, dukaan jiid-iyo-tuur ah, dhisaha badhanka lacag-bixinta ee la gelin karo, sadaqada iyo deeqaha isku-darka ah, CORS iyo amniga.
